create_CompressedTensorsW4A4Mxfp4MoEMeth: create a CompressedTensorsW4A4Mxfp4MoEMethod instance for MXFP4 quantized MoE layers with W4A4 or W4A16 support
create_create_weights: create quantized weight tensors (w13_weight, w2_weight, w13_weight_scale, w2_weight_scale) for an MXFP4 MoE layer
build_get_fused_moe_quant_config: build an FusedMoEQuantConfig for either Cutlass MXFP4 (W4A4) or Marlin weight-only (W4A16) MoE execution
build_process_weights_after_loading: process loaded MXFP4 weights by renaming packed parameters and swizzling scales for Cutlass or preparing Marlin backend
run_apply: run the MXFP4 MoE kernel apply with fused expert weights, top-k routing, and shared expert activation
